mapper.select: SELECT rb.rb_id AS retaBatchId, rb.wb_id AS wholBatchId, ni.name AS retaNodeName, rb.update_time AS applyTime, rb.state AS applyState FROM reta_batch rb INNER JOIN whol_batch wb ON rb.wb_id = wb.wb_id INNER JOIN node_info ni ON rb.node_id = ni.node_id WHERE wb.node_id = #{wholNodeId} AND rb.state IN (2,3) ORDER BY rb.update_time DESC
